title: Executor settings
description: settings.json: the tab's and its server's settings (docs/executor/Settings.md). The one source of defaults, types, ranges, labels and help: tools/standalone validates with it, settings.js makes the dialog from it. x-scope: page (the tab's) or server (tools/standalone's own). x-apply: live, executor (Executor restarts to apply), server (at the server's next start). x-choices: options the page fills in (systems: disk images; screens).

machine.title: Machine
machine.description: The Mac Executor pretends to be.

system.title: System
system.description: Apple's System and Finder from one of your disk images, or Executor's own.

ram_mb.title: Memory (MB)
ram_mb.description: 0: as the System needs (32 MB on Executor's own, 64 on Apple's).

screen.title: Screen size
screen.description: Width x height in Mac pixels.

depth.title: Colours
depth.description: The depth the screen starts in. 256 colours for games that run only in them.

ppc.title: PowerPC
ppc.description: Run fat applications' PowerPC code (PowerPC-only applications always run theirs).

disks.title: Disks
disks.description: Disk images: the library's and your own. Changes to an image are kept beside it (an overlay); the image itself is never written.

mounted.title: Library disks
mounted.description: Disks from the library, mounted in this order (downloaded once, kept in this browser).

images.title: Library folder
images.description: The folder of disk images the server offers (empty: DATA/images).

include.title: Offer
include.description: File name patterns the library offers.

max_image_mb.title: Largest image added (MB)
max_image_mb.description: A disk image the tab adds to the library (written to the disk as it comes).

command_key.title: Command key
command_key.description: The key that is the Mac's Command (⌘). Option and Control are the others, in the order Alt, Ctrl, Meta. The browser keeps some Ctrl shortcuts (Ctrl+W, Ctrl+T) unless the keyboard is captured.
x-labels: Meta (⌘ / Windows key): Alt is Option, Ctrl is Control
Ctrl: Alt is Option, Meta is Control
Alt: Meta is Option, Ctrl is Control

keyboard_capture.title: Capture the keyboard in fullscreen
keyboard_capture.description: In fullscreen, every key goes to the Mac, browser shortcuts too (Keyboard Lock API: Chromium-based browsers; hold Esc to leave).

right_click.title: Right button
right_click.description: What the right mouse button does.

display.title: Display
display.description: How the Mac's screen is shown.

scale.title: Rendering scale
scale.description: Executor draws at this many times the Mac's screen, text from outlines (0: the display's pixel ratio). Programs still see the Mac's size.

smoothing.title: Smooth scaling
smoothing.description: Blend pixels where the screen is enlarged (off: sharp, whole pixels).

fullscreen_button.title: Fullscreen button
fullscreen_button.description: Show a Fullscreen button in the bar (F11 or the browser's own works too).

sound.title: Sound
sound.description: The Mac's sound, through the browser.

enabled.title: Sound
enabled.description: Play the Mac's sound (it starts with the first click or key).

network.title: Network
network.description: The server: who reaches it, and the relay that takes the Mac's TCP and UDP to the Internet.

bind.title: Listen on
bind.description: 127.0.0.1: this computer only. 0.0.0.0 (or ::): the LAN too (with TLS, best). Either way the first browser to open the tab has it until the server restarts.

relay_enabled.title: Relay
relay_enabled.description: Let the Mac's MacTCP and Open Transport reach the Internet through the server.

relay_ports.title: Ports
relay_ports.description: Destination ports the relay connects to: numbers and A-B ranges.

relay_allow_private.title: Private addresses
relay_allow_private.description: Loopback, private and link-local hosts too (your LAN).

relay_max_sockets.title: Sockets
relay_max_sockets.description: At most this many open at once, all tabs together.

relay_max_connections.title: Tabs
relay_max_connections.description: At most this many tabs with the relay open.

relay_nameserver.title: Name server
relay_nameserver.description: For the Mac's DNS lookups (empty: the computer's).

secure_cookies.title: Secure cookies
secure_cookies.description: auto: Secure when served over HTTPS (here, or at a trusted proxy).

tls_cert.title: TLS certificate
tls_cert.description: PEM certificate (chain): serve HTTPS (auto: a self-signed one made once in the data directory, as --tls auto; empty: HTTP).

tls_key.title: TLS key
tls_key.description: Its key (empty: in the certificate's file).

advanced.title: Advanced
advanced.description: Logging and debugging. What the tab prints goes to the server's logs too.

logtraps.title: Log Toolbox calls
logtraps.description: Names, comma-separated (wildcards; -NAME leaves out; 1: all). Empty: none.

logtraps_nesting.title: Nested calls
logtraps_nesting.description: ... and calls nested this deep in Toolbox callbacks.

screenshot_button.title: Screenshot button
screenshot_button.description: Show the bar's Screenshot button (it sends the screen to the server's logs).

data.title: Data folder
data.description: Settings, overlays, Executor's volumes and the logs (--data).
